data.reason: loadLocalEnvironment throws where there is no repository root, which is every deployed container. Its default walks up for pnpm-workspace.yaml and raises when it reaches the filesystem root, and it is called from a bootstrap module imported first by both apps, so after SEEN-007 apps/api and apps/worker would fail to start on Cloud Run with 'No pnpm-workspace.yaml above /app'. The function is documented as doing nothing when there is no file, and no repository root means no file. This ticket exists to make go-live a configuration change, so shipping a boot-time throw on the cloud path is the one defect it cannot afford. Jev put must_fix at yes both times the review gate ran and neither reading cleared the threshold; both times there was something. Returning to tdd.
